quotes.text: Retrieval and memory are not the same thing. One finds information, the other builds on what it already knows.

takeaways: Copilot's Graph grounding is retrieval-augmented generation, which searches from zero on every query and therefore cannot build memory or consistency over time.
The LLM Wiki pattern compiles raw sources once into maintained, cross-linked pages governed by a schema and flags contradictions instead of silently averaging them.
Start with one recurring high-value knowledge domain, clean up its sources with retention, content types and ownership, and give a named owner responsibility for the schema.
hook: Copilot can answer a question perfectly today and fumble the same question tomorrow because it searches instead of remembering. This episode explains why RAG-based Copilot stays shallow and how the LLM Wiki pattern adds compiled, maintained knowledge, for IT leaders and Microsoft 365 architects. You learn how a hybrid Copilot with a wiki layer improves consistency, trust and governance.
